linuxFocused.sanitizers: address,undefined on framing/crop/RoQ probes; native-runtime ABI is mocked

causes: RoQ fixture missing the new Presentation declaration
Packaging snapshot taken between document and linked manifest creation
initialSuite.fixVerification: Both corrected cases passed a focused rerun

limits: Silent runtime probes do not establish audible movie parity
Modern full-image textures replace retail quality 0 padding and quality 1 tiling
Crop padding is cleared and undersized frames retain the complete image
No mouse/keyboard control or OS screen capture
Other renderer/effect and installation/platform gates remain separate
